info.about.heading: About Mock Exams
info.about.body: Mock exams help students practise for the Cambodian baccalaureate entrance tests of ITC, UHS, RUPP and IFL. Choose your institution, pick a subject, and take a realistic timed mock exam to measure your readiness.

info.institutions.heading: Supported Institutions
info.about.institutions.itc: The Institute of Technology of Cambodia (ITC) is the leading public engineering school in Cambodia, offering bachelor's and master's programs in engineering, applied science and technology.
info.about.institutions.uhs: The University of Health Sciences (UHS) is the main public institution training doctors, pharmacists and other health professionals in Cambodia.
info.about.institutions.rupp: The Royal University of Phnom Penh (RUPP) is Cambodia's largest university, offering programs across sciences, social sciences, information technology and more.
info.about.institutions.ifl: The Institute of Foreign Languages (IFL), part of RUPP, is Cambodia's leading institute for language and international studies training.
